title: Language-free Training for Zero-shot Video Grounding
venue: 2023 IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV)

problems.name: Annotation Scarcity and Noisy Supervision
problems.evidence_sentence: Extensive experiments demonstrate the prominence of our language-free training framework, outperforming the existing zero-shot video grounding method and even several weakly-supervised approaches with large margins on two standard datasets. # Introduction In our daily life, we surf, think, and learn through loads of videos.

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: Language-free Training for Zero-shot Video Grounding Given an untrimmed video and a language query depicting a specific temporal moment in the video, video grounding aims to localize the time interval by understanding the text and video simultaneously.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: In this paper, we present a simple yet novel training framework for video grounding in the zero-shot setting, which learns a network with only video data without any annotation.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Especially in such a field, large-scale training data is required to cover numerous video domains (e.g., instructional videos, movies, and so forth).
